Subject: Re: Conductor MSA/DPA/SOW v3 (redlines attached) — Redwood consolidated positions

Hi Jane and Conductor legal team —

Thanks for the submission. We reviewed the materials and attached our consolidated Redwood redline (RDW_redlines_MSA_Conductor_v1.docx). High-level positions:

1) Data residency: Redwood can accept US-only processing for the initial PoC term. For the master contract we propose a clause allowing expansion to additional regions by mutual written agreement.

2) Breach notification: we propose 72 hours for preliminary notification and 24 hours for severe incidents with active data loss (we can define severity in the DPA).

3) Audit scope: Conductor’s requested on-site audit is too broad. We propose: (a) completed security questionnaire (link Soojin provided) plus (b) annual SOC 2 Type II report review, and (c) ad-hoc tabletop exercise with at least 30 days’ notice.

4) Indemnity and cap: Redwood proposes a mutual liability cap equal to the greater of (a) 12 months’ fees paid, or (b) $1,000,000. We are open to commercial exceptions for strategic pilots but need executive sign-off.

5) DPA timelines and data handling: we will accept 48-hour operational notification for incidents that do not meet the severity threshold; 72 hours applies otherwise.

6) PoC SOW: product accepts the technical scope; Marcus to confirm onboarding hours and any premium support needs.

Next steps:
- Conductor: please complete the security questionnaire and provide the SOC 2 report link.
- Redwood/Conductor: review and exchange final redlines by COB Nov 6 so legal can route to signatories and prepare DocuSign.
- If Conductor prefers, we can schedule a 30-minute call with legal/procurement to close open items — propose Nov 4 or Nov 5 morning PST.

Attachments:
- RDW_redlines_MSA_Conductor_v1.docx (Redwood consolidated redline)

Best regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
